note: State recreation area on the Missouri River below Gavins Point Dam, 4 miles west of Yankton off SD-52 via Toe Road; the campground runs along the east shore of the Lake Yankton backwater in cottonwoods. Boat ramp, fishing pier and ten camper cabins; Lewis and Clark Recreation Area and Pierson Ranch adjoin. Water systems may be shut from October through April. --Claude
